question: ‘The Palace of Illusions’, a rendition of the Hindu epic ‘Mahabharata’, was written by which of the following novelists?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chitra Banerjee Divakaruni**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Chitra Banerjee Divakaruni** is the author of '**The Palace of Illusions**', a novel that offers a **rendition of the Hindu epic 'Mahabharata'**.
 
• The book is a retelling of the Mahabharata from the perspective of Draupadi, a central character in the epic.
 
• Chitra Banerjee Divakaruni is an award-winning author, poet, and professor known for her works that explore Indian culture and mythology.
 
• Her other notable works include **'The Mistress of Spices', 'Sister of My Heart', and 'One Amazing Thing'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Pratibha Ray** is a renowned Indian author known for her contributions to Odia literature.
 
• **Devi Yesodharan** is an author known for her historical fiction.
 
• **Indu Sundaresan** is an author known for her historical novels set in India.
